status.show.title: Runtime state
status.show.whenToUse: Read your limits, models, coverage and what is on and off.
status.show.whenNotToUse: Returns operational data about the running instance.

config.set.title: Set a config value
config.set.whenToUse: Override one config key in the local file; takes effect on the next reload.

config.unset.title: Remove a config override
config.unset.whenToUse: Drop a local override so the key falls back to its default.

bot.pause.title: Pause the persona
bot.pause.whenToUse: Stop the persona from speaking and flush memory to disk.

bot.resume.title: Resume the persona
bot.resume.whenToUse: Restart the persona after a pause; refuses if a data file is invalid.

draw.create.title: Draw a picture
draw.create.whenToUse: Generate one picture and, with a channel, post it there as you; costs money, counted against the daily limit.
draw.create.whenNotToUse: A picture that failed to post is already paid for and will not be generated again.

pings.get.title: Notification setting
pings.get.whenToUse: Read whether a member's notifications from you are on or off.

pings.set.title: Change notification setting
pings.set.whenToUse: Turn a member's notifications from you on or off.
pings.set.whenNotToUse: Changes only that member's own setting.

media.status.title: Emoji and GIF state
media.status.whenToUse: Read the custom emoji ranking and GIF library counts.
media.status.whenNotToUse: Does not recount or re-describe anything.

media.rescan.title: Rescan emoji or GIFs
media.rescan.whenToUse: Recount custom emoji or GIF usage from channel history.
media.rescan.whenNotToUse: Runs in the background; a running scan blocks a second one.

media.recache.title: Recache GIFs
media.recache.whenToUse: Re-watch every GIF in the library so their descriptions are current.
media.recache.whenNotToUse: Runs in the background; needs video descriptions on.

model.show.title: Current models
model.show.whenToUse: Read which model serves each role.

model.set.title: Set a model
model.set.whenToUse: Change the model for one role; takes effect on the next request.

route.list.title: Provider routes
route.list.whenToUse: Read every provider route and each role's current model.

route.set.title: Set a route
route.set.whenToUse: Route a model prefix to specific providers, for one role or all.

route.remove.title: Remove a route
route.remove.whenToUse: Delete a model prefix's provider route.

rule.add.title: Add a rule
rule.add.whenToUse: Append a live correction to your rules file; takes effect on the next reload.
rule.add.whenNotToUse: The rule goes into prompts.local/rules.md as text.

rule.list.title: List rules
rule.list.whenToUse: Read the numbered list of live corrections in the rules file.

rule.remove.title: Remove a rule
rule.remove.whenToUse: Delete one rule by number; the text cannot be recovered.

access.grant.title: Grant access
access.grant.whenToUse: Open an operation or group to a user, a role or everyone.
access.grant.whenNotToUse: Administrative, not grantable to you; you never change rights that reach you.

access.revoke.title: Revoke access
access.revoke.whenToUse: Close an operation or group for a user, a role or everyone.
access.revoke.whenNotToUse: Administrative, not grantable to you; you never change rights that reach you.

access.list.title: List grants
access.list.whenToUse: Read every stored access grant and who holds each.

diary.set.title: Set diary channel
diary.set.whenToUse: Pick the channel where you post diary entries.
diary.set.whenNotToUse: Administrative; changes which channel, not the content.

diary.show.title: Diary state
diary.show.whenToUse: Read the diary's status for today: channel, post count, windows.
diary.show.whenNotToUse: Does not post or change anything.

diary.off.title: Stop the diary
diary.off.whenToUse: Turn the diary off; past posts stay, new ones stop.
diary.off.whenNotToUse: Administrative; the diary can be turned back on with diary.set.

diary.post.title: Post a diary entry
diary.post.whenToUse: Write one diary entry now; an optional kind and topic steer the post.
diary.post.whenNotToUse: Refuses when the diary has no channel or the daily cap is hit.

alias.add.title: Add an alias
alias.add.whenToUse: Record or strengthen a nickname people in chat use for a member.
alias.add.whenNotToUse: Only what people actually call the member, not display names.

alias.remove.title: Remove an alias
alias.remove.whenToUse: Delete a stored alias from a member's profile.

learning.add.title: Add a lesson
learning.add.whenToUse: Record or strengthen something people taught you.
learning.add.whenNotToUse: Only things addressed to you, not general facts.

learning.remove.title: Remove a lesson
learning.remove.whenToUse: Delete a stored lesson by number.

lore.add.title: Add a lore entry
lore.add.whenToUse: Create or overwrite a lorebook entry: title, trigger keys, text.
lore.add.whenNotToUse: Becomes an owner entry; the analyzer will not change it.

lore.list.title: List lore
lore.list.whenToUse: Read lorebook entries, optionally filtered by a substring of title or keys.
lore.list.whenNotToUse: Does not show the full text; lore.show does.

lore.show.title: Show a lore entry
lore.show.whenToUse: Read one lorebook entry in full.

lore.remove.title: Remove a lore entry
lore.remove.whenToUse: Delete one lorebook entry by id.

memory.profile.read.title: Read a profile
memory.profile.read.whenToUse: Read a member's stored profile: character, style, interests, details, episodes or raw data.
memory.profile.read.whenNotToUse: Returns what you remember publicly, not what the member said in DMs.

memory.channel.read.title: Read channel notes
memory.channel.read.whenToUse: Read one channel's stored notes, or a table of all stored channels.

memory.server.read.title: Read server notes
memory.server.read.whenToUse: Read the server's patterns, starters, in-jokes and self-facts.

memory.recent.read.title: Read recent events
memory.recent.read.whenToUse: Read the live list of recent notes from the last few days.
memory.recent.read.whenNotToUse: Does not add or remove notes.

memory.refresh.user.title: Refresh a portrait
memory.refresh.user.whenToUse: Rewrite a member's character and style from a fresh sample of their messages.
memory.refresh.user.whenNotToUse: Sends one request; counts against the daily cap.

memory.refresh.channel.title: Refresh channel notes
memory.refresh.channel.whenToUse: Rewrite a channel's notes from a fresh spread of recent messages.
memory.refresh.channel.whenNotToUse: Sends one request; counts against the daily cap.

memory.refresh.server.title: Refresh server notes
memory.refresh.server.whenToUse: Rewrite the server's patterns, starters and in-jokes from channel and member summaries.
memory.refresh.server.whenNotToUse: Sends one request; counts against the daily cap.

memory.forget.title: Forget a member
memory.forget.whenToUse: Delete a member's profile, private memory, versions and record entries; a vault copy is saved first.

memory.affinity.read.title: Read attitude
memory.affinity.read.whenToUse: Read your attitude score, band and reason for a member.

memory.wipe.title: Wipe all memory
memory.wipe.whenToUse: Delete every stored profile, channel note, habit, lore entry and private memory for the whole server; a vault copy is saved first.

memory.journal.read.title: Read journal
memory.journal.read.whenToUse: Read your journal records for a day, optionally filtered by kind, or the full record of the turn behind one of your messages.

memory.archive.read.title: Read archive
memory.archive.read.whenToUse: Read archived items: evicted episodes, expired interests, old notes.
memory.archive.read.whenNotToUse: Does not restore anything; memory.restore does.

memory.restore.title: Restore from archive
memory.restore.whenToUse: Put an archived item back into active memory, replacing what is stored at its position.

memory.snapshot.title: Snapshot data
memory.snapshot.whenToUse: Copy the data directory to a timestamped directory for tools.
memory.snapshot.whenNotToUse: Does not change any live data.

memory.private.read.title: Read private memory
memory.private.read.whenToUse: Read what you remember from private conversations with a member.
memory.private.read.whenNotToUse: Private data; only the owner sees the reply.

memory.private.forget.title: Forget private memory
memory.private.forget.whenToUse: Delete a member's private DM memory; the public profile stays.

memory.private.purge.title: Purge private chat
memory.private.purge.whenToUse: Delete a member's private memory and bulk-delete your DM messages to them.
memory.private.purge.whenNotToUse: Destructive, irreversible for the messages, not grantable to you.

message.create.title: Post a message
message.create.whenToUse: Post a message in a conversation you have access to, optionally as a reply; a reply notifies the author unless they turned pings off.
message.create.whenNotToUse: Only in conversations you may write in.

message.edit.title: Edit your message
message.edit.whenToUse: Replace the text of one of your own earlier messages; takes a #N or a message link. message="last" picks your most recent message in that channel, even one not in the chat you see.

message.delete.title: Delete your message
message.delete.whenToUse: Remove one of your own messages; takes a #N or a message link. message="last" picks your most recent message in that channel, even one not in the chat you see. Irreversible.
message.delete.whenNotToUse: Only your own messages; the text is gone once deleted.

message.react.add.title: Add a reaction
message.react.add.whenToUse: Place an emoji reaction on a message; takes a #N or a message link.
message.react.add.whenNotToUse: Only in conversations you have access to.

message.react.remove.title: Remove your reaction
message.react.remove.whenToUse: Take back one of your own reactions from a message; takes a #N or a message link.

task.run.title: Hand off an errand
task.run.whenToUse: Give an agent a job that takes a while: web searches the internet, reads pages, looks at pictures and downloads files; server reads this machine. You get the result later in a turn of your own; costs money. Set adult for a web errand whose subject is erotic or explicit material about adults; the default web model refuses or sanitizes those requests, and the alternative is slower.
task.run.whenNotToUse: Not for what you can answer now; server only when an owner asks; daily and open-task limits apply.

task.status.title: Check an errand
task.status.whenToUse: Read the state of one errand by its id, or of the open ones.
task.status.whenNotToUse: Open and newly finished errands are already in your tasks block.

task.cancel.title: Cancel an errand
task.cancel.whenToUse: Stop an open errand by its id.
task.cancel.whenNotToUse: Only for its requester or an owner; a finished errand cannot be cancelled.

task.list.title: List errands
task.list.whenToUse: Read the latest ten errands with their states.
